=== workflows ===
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  quality:
    name: Quality Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      ADMIN_TOKEN: dev-admin-token
      CLAIM_TOKEN_SECRET: ci-claim-token-secret
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: backend/requirements.txt

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json

      - name: Install backend dependencies
        run: python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt

      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Playwright Chromium
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Run project quality gate
        run: make quality

      - name: Upload failure diagnostics
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: quality-diagnostics
          path: |
            .dev/**/*.log
            frontend/test-results/**
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 3
name: Sandbox Pack

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - "work/**"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      include_offline_dependencies:
        description: "Build and upload Python/npm/Playwright offline pack"
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: sandbox-pack-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  pack:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Record source and dependency identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .sandbox-pack/meta
          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > .sandbox-pack/meta/git-sha.txt
          {
            sha256sum backend/requirements.txt
            sha256sum backend/pyproject.toml
            sha256sum frontend/package.json
            sha256sum frontend/package-lock.json
            sha256sum tools/sandbox/bootstrap-sandbox.sh
            sha256sum tools/sandbox/sandbox-doctor.sh
            sha256sum tools/sandbox/run-sandbox-check.sh
            printf '%s\n' 'python=3.13'
            printf '%s\n' 'node=22'
          } > .sandbox-pack/meta/dependency-inputs.sha256
          sha256sum .sandbox-pack/meta/dependency-inputs.sha256 | awk '{print $1}' > .sandbox-pack/meta/dependency-key.txt

      - name: Create exact source snapshot
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ROOT=.sandbox-pack/source-root
          mkdir -p "$ROOT/.sandbox-snapshot"
          git archive --format=tar HEAD | tar -xf - -C "$ROOT"
          cp .sandbox-pack/meta/git-sha.txt "$ROOT/.sandbox-snapshot/git-sha.txt"
          cp .sandbox-pack/meta/dependency-key.txt "$ROOT/.sandbox-snapshot/dependency-key.txt"
          tar -C "$ROOT" -cf - . | zstd -T0 -10 -o "photomap-source-${GITHUB_SHA}.tar.zst"
          sha256sum "photomap-source-${GITHUB_SHA}.tar.zst" > "photomap-source-${GITHUB_SHA}.tar.zst.sha256"

      - name: Upload source snapshot
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: photomap-source-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            photomap-source-${{ github.sha }}.tar.zst
            photomap-source-${{ github.sha }}.tar.zst.sha256
            .sandbox-pack/meta/git-sha.txt
            .sandbox-pack/meta/dependency-key.txt
            .sandbox-pack/meta/dependency-inputs.sha256
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 0

      - name: Decide whether offline pack is needed
        id: offline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" && "${{ inputs.include_offline_dependencies }}" == "true" ]] || \
             [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "push" && "${{ contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[sandbox-offline]') }}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "enabled=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "enabled=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Set up Python 3.13
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Set up Node 22
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Build Python wheelhouse
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .sandbox-pack/offline/python-wheelhouse
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel
          python -m pip wheel \
            --wheel-dir .sandbox-pack/offline/python-wheelhouse \
            -r backend/requirements.txt

      - name: Warm npm cache
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .sandbox-pack/offline/npm-cache
          cd frontend
          npm ci --cache "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.sandbox-pack/offline/npm-cache" --prefer-offline

      - name: Download Playwright Chromium
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        shell: bash
        env:
          PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/.sandbox-pack/offline/ms-playwright
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd frontend
          npx playwright install chromium

      - name: Validate offline install inputs
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        shell: bash
        env:
          PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/.sandbox-pack/offline/ms-playwright
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$(find .sandbox-pack/offline/python-wheelhouse -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.whl' -print -quit)"
          test -d .sandbox-pack/offline/npm-cache/_cacache
          test -n "$(find .sandbox-pack/offline/ms-playwright -type f \( -name chrome -o -name headless_shell \) -print -quit)"
          mkdir -p .sandbox-pack/offline/meta
          cp .sandbox-pack/meta/git-sha.txt .sandbox-pack/offline/meta/
          cp .sandbox-pack/meta/dependency-key.txt .sandbox-pack/offline/meta/
          cp .sandbox-pack/meta/dependency-inputs.sha256 .sandbox-pack/offline/meta/

      - name: Build and split offline pack
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          KEY=$(cat .sandbox-pack/meta/dependency-key.txt)
          mkdir -p .sandbox-pack/chunks
          PACK="photomap-offline-${KEY}.tar.zst"
          tar -C .sandbox-pack -cf - offline | zstd -T0 -10 -o "$PACK"
          sha256sum "$PACK" > .sandbox-pack/chunks/full-pack.sha256
          printf '%s\n' "$PACK" > .sandbox-pack/chunks/full-pack.name
          split -b 180M -d -a 2 "$PACK" .sandbox-pack/chunks/part-
          sha256sum .sandbox-pack/chunks/part-* > .sandbox-pack/chunks/parts.sha256
          ls -lh .sandbox-pack/chunks

      - name: Upload offline manifest
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: photomap-offline-manifest
          path: |
            .sandbox-pack/chunks/full-pack.name
            .sandbox-pack/chunks/full-pack.sha256
            .sandbox-pack/chunks/parts.sha256
            .sandbox-pack/meta/dependency-key.txt
            .sandbox-pack/meta/dependency-inputs.sha256
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 0

      - name: Upload offline part 00
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: photomap-offline-part-00
          path: .sandbox-pack/chunks/part-00
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 0

      - name: Upload offline part 01
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: photomap-offline-part-01
          path: .sandbox-pack/chunks/part-01
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 0

      - name: Upload offline part 02
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: photomap-offline-part-02
          path: .sandbox-pack/chunks/part-02
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 0

      - name: Upload offline part 03
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: photomap-offline-part-03
          path: .sandbox-pack/chunks/part-03
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 0

      - name: Upload offline part 04
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: photomap-offline-part-04
          path: .sandbox-pack/chunks/part-04
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 0

      - name: Upload offline part 05
        if: steps.offline.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: photomap-offline-part-05
          path: .sandbox-pack/chunks/part-05
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 0
=== bootstrap ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT=${1:-/mnt/data/photomap-sandbox}
OFFLINE_DIR=${2:-${PHOTOMAP_OFFLINE_DIR:-}}
SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
REPO_ROOT=$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)

if [[ -z "$OFFLINE_DIR" ]]; then
  echo "Offline dependency directory is required." >&2
  echo "Usage: $0 <sandbox-root> <extracted-offline-pack>" >&2
  exit 2
fi

for required in \
  "$OFFLINE_DIR/python-wheelhouse" \
  "$OFFLINE_DIR/npm-cache" \
  "$OFFLINE_DIR/ms-playwright" \
  "$OFFLINE_DIR/meta/dependency-key.txt"; do
  if [[ ! -e "$required" ]]; then
    echo "Missing offline-pack component: $required" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
done

PYTHON_BIN=${PYTHON_BIN:-python3}
NODE_BIN=${NODE_BIN:-node}

python_version=$($PYTHON_BIN -c 'import sys; print(f"{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}")')
if [[ "$python_version" != "3.13" ]]; then
  echo "Sandbox pack requires Python 3.13; found $python_version" >&2
  exit 4
fi

node_major=$($NODE_BIN -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]')
if [[ "$node_major" != "22" ]]; then
  echo "Sandbox pack requires Node 22; found $($NODE_BIN --version)" >&2
  exit 5
fi

mkdir -p "$ROOT"/{logs,tmp,npm-cache}

if [[ ! -x "$ROOT/venv/bin/python" ]]; then
  "$PYTHON_BIN" -m venv "$ROOT/venv"
fi

"$ROOT/venv/bin/python" -m pip install \
  --disable-pip-version-check \
  --no-index \
  --find-links "$OFFLINE_DIR/python-wheelhouse" \
  -r "$REPO_ROOT/backend/requirements.txt"

rm -rf "$ROOT/npm-cache"
mkdir -p "$ROOT/npm-cache"
cp -a "$OFFLINE_DIR/npm-cache/." "$ROOT/npm-cache/"

(
  cd "$REPO_ROOT/frontend"
  npm ci --offline --cache "$ROOT/npm-cache" --prefer-offline
)

# Knip 6.16 uses oxc-parser raw transfer on Node 22. That path reserves a ~6 GiB
# ArrayBuffer and cannot run inside the current 4 GiB sandbox cgroup. Disable only
# the experimental transfer mode in disposable node_modules; project source is untouched.
KNIP_AST="$REPO_ROOT/frontend/node_modules/knip/dist/typescript/ast-nodes.js"
"$ROOT/venv/bin/python" - "$KNIP_AST" <<'PY_PATCH'
from pathlib import Path
import sys

path = Path(sys.argv[1])
text = path.read_text()
old = "experimentalRawTransfer: rawTransferSupported(),"
new = "experimentalRawTransfer: false,"
if old in text:
    path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
elif new not in text:
    raise SystemExit("Unsupported Knip/oxc-parser layout; refresh sandbox bootstrap")
PY_PATCH

cat > "$ROOT/env.sh" <<ENV
export PHOTOMAP_SANDBOX_ROOT="$ROOT"
export PHOTOMAP_REPO_ROOT="$REPO_ROOT"
export PHOTOMAP_OFFLINE_DIR="$OFFLINE_DIR"
export VIRTUAL_ENV="$ROOT/venv"
export PYTHON="$ROOT/venv/bin/python"
export NPM_CONFIG_CACHE="$ROOT/npm-cache"
export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH="$OFFLINE_DIR/ms-playwright"
export TMPDIR="$ROOT/tmp"
export CI=1
export PATH="$ROOT/venv/bin:\$PATH"
ENV

printf 'PhotoMap sandbox prepared at %s\n' "$ROOT"
printf 'Dependency key: %s\n' "$(cat "$OFFLINE_DIR/meta/dependency-key.txt")"
printf 'Next: source %s/env.sh && tools/sandbox/sandbox-doctor.sh\n' "$ROOT"
